PREVENTION AND CONTROL OF INFECTIOUS DISEASES ACT 1988

PREVENTION AND CONTROL OF INFECTIOUS DISEASES

(MEASURES WITHIN INFECTED LOCAL AREAS) (RECOVERY MOVEMENT CONTROL)

(NO. 3) (AMENDMENT) (NO. 10) REGULATIONS 2021

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 11(2) of

the Prevention and Control of Infectious Diseases Act 1988 [Act 342],

the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Prevention and Control of

Infectious Diseases (Measures within Infected Local Areas) (Recovery Movement

Control) (No. 3) (Amendment) (No. 10) Regulations 2021.

(2) These Regulations come into operation on 15 April 2021.

Substitution of First Schedule

2. The Prevention and Control of Infectious Diseases (Measures within

Infected Local Areas) (Recovery Movement Control) (No. 3) Regulations 2021

[P.U. (A) 98/2021] are amended by substituting for the First Schedule

the following schedule:

"FIRST SCHEDULE

APPLICATION

[Regulation 2]

(1)

Infected Local Area/Division/District

(2)

Period

1. State of Kedah except Kuala Muda District 15.4.2021 – 28.4.2021

2. State of Malacca 15.4.2021 – 28.4.2021

3. State of Negeri Sembilan except Seremban District 15.4.2021 – 28.4.2021

4. State of Pahang 15.4.2021 – 28.4.2021

(1)

Infected Local Area/Division/District

(2)

5. State of Perak 15.4.2021 – 28.4.2021

6. State of Perlis 15.4.2021 – 28.4.2021

7. State of Sabah except Keningau, Tawau and Lahad

Datu Districts

15.4.2021 – 28.4.2021

8. State of Terengganu 15.4.2021 – 28.4.2021

9. Federal Territory of Putrajaya 15.4.2021 – 28.4.2021

10. Federal Territory of Labuan 15.4.2021 – 28.4.2021".
